name: Technology
description: Software, data, IT and product roles.
reviewer: a senior engineer and hiring manager in software, data and IT
impact: features shipped, users served, performance and reliability gains, time or cost saved, defects reduced, systems supported

name: Healthcare
description: Clinical, care, pharmacy and health administration roles.
reviewer: a senior nurse, clinical educator and healthcare hiring manager who assesses clinical competence
impact: patient outcomes, patient safety and incidents avoided, quality of care, number of patients cared for, audit and compliance results, waiting times

name: Education
description: Teaching, tutoring and support roles in schools, early years and beyond.
reviewer: an experienced head teacher and teacher mentor who observes lessons and reviews planning
impact: student progress and results, attainment and exam pass rates, attendance and engagement, class sizes, lesson observation feedback, curriculum developed

name: Finance & Accounting
description: Accounting, audit, analysis, payroll and banking roles.
reviewer: a chartered accountant and finance manager who hires and supervises accountants
impact: accuracy, audit findings, month-end close time, errors reduced, cost savings, compliance, value of accounts or budgets managed

name: Marketing
description: Brand, digital, content and campaign roles.
reviewer: a marketing director who hires marketers and reviews campaigns, content and results
impact: leads generated, conversion rates, reach and engagement, campaign ROI, traffic growth, cost per acquisition, audience growth

name: Sales
description: Selling, account management and business development roles.
reviewer: a sales director who hires and coaches sales people
impact: revenue closed, quota attainment, pipeline built, leads and meetings booked, conversion and win rates, deal size, accounts retained

name: Design & Creative
description: Visual design, UX, media and creative production roles.
reviewer: a creative director who reviews portfolios and hires designers and creatives
impact: projects delivered, client or user feedback, engagement with the work, usability improvements, awards, deadlines met

name: Engineering
description: Mechanical, civil, electrical, chemical and quality engineering roles.
reviewer: a chartered engineer and engineering manager who reviews technical work and designs
impact: designs delivered, safety and compliance, cost and material savings, efficiency gains, defects or failures reduced, project value and timelines

name: Hospitality
description: Hotels, restaurants, cafés, events and tourism roles.
reviewer: an experienced hospitality operations manager who hires kitchen, front-of-house and hotel staff
impact: guest satisfaction and reviews, covers or rooms served, repeat guests, food safety and hygiene ratings, upselling, speed of service

name: Skilled Trades
description: Electrical, plumbing, construction, mechanical and repair trades.
reviewer: a master tradesperson and site supervisor who inspects work and trains apprentices
impact: jobs completed, quality and inspection results, safety record, time and materials saved, compliance with codes, repeat customers

name: Legal
description: Legal practice, support and compliance roles.
reviewer: a senior lawyer and legal recruiter who reviews drafting, research and qualifications
impact: cases or matters handled, outcomes achieved, contracts drafted or negotiated, deadlines met, risk reduced, compliance

name: Government & Public Sector
description: Policy, public administration, social services and public safety roles.
reviewer: a senior public-sector manager who hires for policy, administration and frontline services
impact: people and communities served, policies or programmes delivered, service targets met, processing times, budgets managed, compliance

name: Research & Academia
description: Research, laboratory and university teaching roles.
reviewer: a professor and principal investigator who reviews research, publications and teaching
impact: publications, grants won, studies completed, students taught or supervised, citations, methods developed, presentations given

name: Customer Service
description: Support, contact centre, reception and customer success roles.
reviewer: a customer service manager who hires, coaches and quality-checks support staff
impact: customer satisfaction scores, resolution rates, first-contact resolution, response times, volume of contacts handled, complaints resolved

name: Operations & Logistics
description: Operations, supply chain, warehousing, procurement and transport roles.
reviewer: an operations and supply chain manager who hires and assesses logistics staff
impact: on-time delivery, cost reduction, inventory accuracy, throughput, safety record, process improvements, suppliers managed

name: Human Resources
description: HR, recruitment, learning and people operations roles.
reviewer: an HR director who hires HR staff and reviews people-management work
impact: roles filled and time to hire, retention, engagement scores, employee relations cases resolved, training delivered, policy compliance
